test_title: PYST 65: RRB Group D - GS (Held On: 26 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements accurately describes the characteristic of electrons in an atom?

options.text: They revolve around the nucleus in fixed orbits.
They are located in the nucleus.
They have the same mass as protons.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They revolve around the nucleus in fixed orbits.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electrons** are subatomic particles that revolve around the central **nucleus** of an atom in specific circular paths known as **orbits** or **shells**. These orbits represent discrete **energy levels**. *Hence, statement 1 is correct.*
 
• The **nucleus** at the center of the atom contains **protons** and **neutrons**, which are collectively called **nucleons**. Electrons are located in the **extranuclear region** outside the nucleus. *Hence, statement 2 is incorrect.*
 
• The mass of an electron is approximately **9.11 x 10^-31 kg**, which is about **1/1836** times the mass of a **proton** or a hydrogen atom. Because it is so small, its mass is usually considered **negligible**. *Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.*
 
• **Electrons** carry a **negative electric charge** of magnitude **1.602 x 10^-19 Coulombs**. In contrast, **protons** are **positively charged**. *Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is They revolve around the nucleus in fixed orbits.__***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Discovery of the Electron:**
 
 
• The **electron** was discovered by **Sir J.J. Thomson** in **1897** during his experiments with **cathode ray tubes**.
 
• He observed that the rays were deflected by electric and magnetic fields, suggesting they consisted of **negatively charged particles**.
 
 
 
• **Bohr's Model of an Atom:**
 
 
• Proposed by **Niels Bohr** in **1913**, this model refined the idea of **electron orbits**.
 
• He stated that electrons move in **fixed circular orbits** without radiating energy. These orbits are designated by letters **K, L, M, N** or principal quantum numbers **n = 1, 2, 3, 4**.
 
 
 
• **Charge and Mass:**
 
 
• The **charge-to-mass ratio (e/m)** was first calculated by **J.J. Thomson**.
 
• The precise **negative charge** of the electron was later determined by **Robert Millikan** through the **Oil Drop Experiment** in **1909**.
 
 
 
• **Valence Electrons:**
 
 
• Electrons in the **outermost shell** are called **valence electrons**. They are responsible for the **chemical properties** and **valency** of an element.
 
• The maximum number of electrons that can be accommodated in a shell is given by the formula **2n²**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Atomic Neutrality:** An atom is **electrically neutral** because the **number of electrons** (negative charge) is equal to the **number of protons** (positive charge) in the nucleus.
 
• **Subatomic Mass:** The **atomic mass** of an element is almost entirely due to the **nucleus** (protons + neutrons), as the **electron mass** is so tiny (**0.0005485 amu**).
 
• **Quantum Nature:** In modern **Quantum Mechanics** (developed by **Schrödinger** in **1926**), electrons are described as existing in **orbitals**, which are regions of **high probability** rather than strict circular tracks.
